title: A subgroup of least prime index is normal
statement: Let $G$ be a group with finite underlying set [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set] and $|G|>1$, and let $H\subseteq G$ be a subgroup (a subset containing $1$ and closed under multiplication and inverse). Let $q$ be the smallest prime divisor of the positive integer $|G|$. If $[G:H]=q$, then $gHg^{-1}=H$ for every $g\in G$. Here $|G|$ counts elements and $[G:H]$ counts left cosets.
